data.claim: P-constellation (45 tasks, 0 done) and P-app-infra (16, 0 done) plan owner-to-consumer propagation (CR with per-consumer states, matrix, drift audit, mirror) but not ONE logical change tracked as a set of per-repo items with Depends-On ordering, a joint speculative gate, a landing saga with partial-failure recovery, cross-repo write consent or loop/blast-radius guards; the only shipped cross-repo mechanism is read-only needs=name:ID with ddflow external sync over [schedule] repos. A read-only subset (manifest relations, sibling reader, impact report, drift report) can ship on top of the shipped external.py without waiting for CN-mirror (wave 10) or CN-sync (wave 11). Proposed: phase P-constellation-ops, 24 MR- tasks, writes only as reviewed proposals.
data.falsifier: A four-repo fake fixture (code, tests, docs, contract): a contract edit does not list exactly the declared consumers in the impact report, or a change that passes in each repo alone fails the joint gate yet still lands, or an A->B->A proposal loops, or an agent in A writes into B without a grant.
data.mechanism: Generalize services/external.py into a sibling reader; change set = data-declared kind (SE-kind-data) of per-repo members with Depends-On DAG; joint gate = throwaway integration workspace at frozen SHAs (west --freeze / Zuul queue item frozen repo state) keyed by SHA tuple; landing in topological order as a non-atomic saga (Gerrit submitWholeTopic is only atomic inside one Gerrit); writes via forge PRs under the person login (D-app-infra) or the target own ddflow (proposed XP-target-project); contract-diff via oasdiff/buf breaking as ADP-tools checks.
data.probe: ddflow list task --phase P-constellation; ddflow waves; read ddflow/services/external.py, core/schedule.py is_external; ddflow search of Depends-On/Copybara/change set; WebFetch of Zuul gating, west manifest, Pact can-i-deploy, buf breaking, Nx affected, Sourcegraph Batch Changes, Backstage descriptor, Argo CD app-of-apps, Dependabot options, Moderne, vcstool, Claude Code large-codebases
data.probe_output: P-constellation 0/45, P-app-infra 0/16, CN-manifest wave 0, CN-mirror wave 10, CN-sync wave 11, no Depends-On or Copybara or joint-gate record exists, external.py reads sibling logs read-only; MCP Server is bound to one repo (Server.__init__(repo)); no ddflow/services/org dir
data.question: How should ddflow coordinate changes across sister repositories (code, tests, docs, research, infra, security, libraries, shared contracts) so they stay in sync, and what must be added to the planned P-constellation and P-app-infra?
